title: Correcting Someone Privately
paragraphs: Selama presentasi tim, Hana menyadari rekan kerjanya mengutip statistik yang sudah usang yang bisa memalukannya jika klien menemukan kesalahan itu nanti selama diskusi proyek yang sebenarnya. Alih-alih mengoreksinya di depan semua orang, ia menunggu sampai rapat berakhir dan menyebutkannya dengan tenang di lorong, memberinya waktu untuk memperbaiki slide sebelum sampai ke klien.

Rekan kerjanya berterima kasih dengan tulus, mengakui bahwa dikoreksi secara pribadi terasa sama sekali berbeda dari saat-saat rekan kerja lain menunjukkan kesalahannya di depan seluruh ruangan. Hana menyadari bahwa cara mengoreksi, bukan hanya ketepatannya, sering menentukan apakah seseorang merasa dibantu atau dipermalukan oleh masukan yang sama.
answerKey: During a team presentation, Hana noticed her colleague citing an outdated statistic that could embarrass him if a client caught the error later during the actual project discussion. Rather than correcting him in front of everyone, she waited until the meeting ended and mentioned it quietly in the hallway, giving him time to fix the slide before it reached the client. Her colleague thanked her sincerely, admitting that being corrected privately felt entirely different from the times other coworkers had pointed out his mistakes in front of the whole room. Hana realized that the manner of correction, not just its accuracy, often determined whether someone felt helped or humiliated by the same piece of feedback.
